DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Here is the book you reserved.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 題名は合いますが、必要なのは新版です。この版を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受取本の版を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The title matches, but I need the new edition. I would like to check which edition this is.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check the edition of the book you are collecting in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will look at the reservation record.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 版を指定せず予約したかもしれません。先に借りた扱いにしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 指定不足か不明で貸出を止める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I may have reserved it without specifying the edition. Please do not check it out to me yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you are unsure whether you specified enough and ask to hold off lending it.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発行年の希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you need a particular publication year?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今年の内容です。試験用なので古い情報では困ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 必要年と用途を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I need this year's content. It is for an exam, so outdated information would be a problem.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the required year and purpose in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 新版の所蔵と予約を調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check our holdings and reservations for the new edition.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 旧版の予約を残すかも、結果を見て決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旧予約の扱いを結果後に決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would also like to decide whether to keep the old-edition reservation after seeing the result.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will decide what to do with the old reservation after the result.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらはまだ貸出処理していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We have not processed this as a loan yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。版と予約状況が分かるまで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未貸出を確認して待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will wait until the edition and reservation situation are clear.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that it has not been checked out and say you will wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 貸出は保留しました。新版の所蔵と予約方法を確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have put the loan on hold. I will check whether we have the new edition and how to reserve it, then explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to check your medicines?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私と家族の袋が一緒になりました。自分の分を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 混ざった二人の薬を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My medicine bags and a family member's have become mixed together. I would like to check which are mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Consult in Japanese about two people's medicines becoming mixed.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋の名前を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the names on the bags.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。家族の薬を自分の分として飲んでいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 名義と他人分未服用を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here they are. I have not taken my family member's medicine as my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the names and state in Japanese that you have not taken the other person's medicine.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 服用中の記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have a record of medicines you are taking?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分の手帳があります。家族の記録とは分けて示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人手帳を別に提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have my own medication notebook. I will show it separately from my family member's record.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Present your own medication notebook separately in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 薬剤師が内容を照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: A pharmacist will compare the contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 色だけで選ばず、名前と指示で確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 外観で選ばず照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please check using the names and instructions rather than choosing by color alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a comparison rather than selecting by appearance.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 家族の袋はここでまとめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please gather your family member's bags together here.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。二人分を別袋にし、確認後の自分の説明を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 袋を分け本人の説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will put each person's medicines in a separate bag and hear the explanation for my own after they are checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate the bags and request your own explanation in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 薬剤師へ二人分の袋と本人の手帳を引き継ぎます。服用方法は照合後に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will hand both people's medicine bags and your notebook to the pharmacist. Please confirm how to take the medicines after they are compared.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to check the ingredients?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 乳を避けています。自分のソースを持っても、料理自体の確認が必要ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持参ソースと料理適合を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I avoid milk. Even if I bring my own sauce, the dish itself still needs checking, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Distinguish bringing your own sauce from the dish's suitability in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい。持込の扱いも担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes. We will also ask the responsible staff about bringing food in.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 勝手に足さず、容器の表示を必要な範囲で見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 無断追加せず表示を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will not add it without permission, and I will show the container label as far as needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not add it without permission and will show the label.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 候補の料理はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Is there a dish you are considering?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 温野菜です。店で使う油と調理器具も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 候補と調理条件を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: The warm vegetables. I also want to check the oil and utensils the restaurant uses.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State your dish choice and check its preparation conditions in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 対応可否を担当が説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The responsible staff will explain whether we can accommodate your needs.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分のソースがあるから安全とは言わず、説明後に選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持参だけで適合と決めない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not say it is safe just because I have my own sauce; I will choose after hearing the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that bringing your own sauce alone does not establish suitability.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 持込を認められない場合もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We may not be able to allow you to use something brought in.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その場合、無理に使わず、対応できる料理がないなら注文をやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持込不可と注文中止の代案を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: In that case, I will not insist on using it, and if no suitable dish is available, I will not order.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State in Japanese your alternatives if outside sauce is not permitted, including not ordering.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 料理の条件と持込の扱いを別に確認します。注文とソース使用は保留します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-EBINA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check the dish conditions and rules for outside food separately. We will hold off both ordering and using the sauce.

DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご出発の準備についてですか。
DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about getting ready to leave?

DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 遊泳終了の放送を聞きました。この店の会計も今すぐ締め切りですか。
DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 遊泳終了と店の精算締切を区別して尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-02.translation: I heard the announcement that swimming has ended. Does that also mean this shop's payment deadline is right now?
DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese while distinguishing the end of swimming from the shop's payment deadline.

DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 遊泳の案内と当店の精算時刻は別です。会計はこの掲示の時刻までです。
DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-03.translation: The swimming announcement and our payment time are separate. Payment is available until the time on this notice.

DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。子どもはもう水から上がっています。同行者が着替えている間に支払えますか。
DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 子どもの現在の状態と支払う順番を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. My child is already out of the water. Can I pay while my companion changes clothes?
DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Discuss in Japanese your child's current situation and the order of payment.

DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まとめてのお支払いですか。追加注文は終わっていますか。
DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Will you pay together? Have you finished any additional orders?

DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族の一卓分です。追加しないことは全員と決めました。使ったロッカー代も一緒か確認したいです。
DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 追加終了の合意とロッカー代の扱いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is for my family's one table. We have all agreed not to order more. I also want to check whether the locker charge is included.
DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese everyone's agreement to stop ordering and how the locker fee is handled.

DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この伝票は飲食分です。ロッカーの精算は別の窓口です。
DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-07.translation: This bill is for food and drinks. Locker payment is handled at a separate counter.

DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では飲食分だけここで確認します。同じ代金を別の窓口でも払わないよう、領収書を受け取ります。
DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 飲食分に限定し領収書で二重払いを避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will check only the food and drinks here. I will get a receipt so I do not pay the same charge again at another counter.
DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Limit payment to food and drinks and explain in Japanese how the receipt avoids double payment.

DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ロッカーの札はどなたがお持ちですか。

DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 着替え中の同行者です。私が会計を終えたら札を持って一緒に窓口へ行くと伝えます。
DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 札を持つ同行者と次の窓口へ行く段取りを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-10.translation: My companion who is changing clothes. I will tell them that when I finish paying, we will take the tag to the other counter together.
DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese the plan to visit the next counter with the companion holding the tag.

DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 飲食の明細をこちらで確認しましょう。精算後は領収書をお渡しします。ロッカーは札をお持ちの方と別の窓口でご相談ください。
DLG-SC-KNG-FUJISAWA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us check the food-and-drink details here. After payment, we will give you a receipt. Please ask about the locker at the separate counter with the person holding its tag.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗る位置をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for where to board?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が先頭と言っていますが、私は逆向きの列車を見ていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 逆方向の先頭位置混同を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend says the front car, but I was looking at a train going the opposite way.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you confused the front-car position for the opposite direction.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are you going to the same destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私の列車は違います。まず友人の行先を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人の行先を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: My train is different. I will ask my friend's destination first.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm your friend's destination in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 時刻も合わせて確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the time together too.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 十時十五分の便だそうです。車両位置だけで乗りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 便時刻を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: They say it is the ten-fifteen service. I will not board based only on the car position.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Compare the service time in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その便の乗場はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The boarding area for that service is here.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 移動します。友人へ同じ便を待つことを伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同便待機を連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will move there. I will tell my friend I am waiting for the same service.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell your friend in Japanese that you will wait for the same service.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 混雑時は無理に先頭へ移動しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: When it is crowded, do not force your way to the front car.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。合流できなければ降りた駅で会います。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 無理な車内移動を避け代案を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. If we cannot meet, we will meet at the station where we get off.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Avoid forcing your way through the train and state an alternative in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この乗場で行先と時刻を確認してお待ちください。先頭位置は同じ進行方向で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait at this boarding area after checking the destination and time. The front-car position can be checked for the same direction of travel.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご試食はいかがですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません、小麦を避けるので、まだ食べずに確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 試食前の小麦制限を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sorry, I avoid wheat, so I would like to check before eating any.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State your wheat restriction before sampling in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 購入候補も同じ商品ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the item you are considering buying the same product?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。試食なら量が少ないからよい、とは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 少量試食を例外としない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I do not assume that a small sample is an exception just because it is a small amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that a small sample is not an exception.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 材料と調理条件を担当へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will ask the responsible staff about ingredients and preparation conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 試食と販売品で味付けが違うかも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 試食と販売品の条件差を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please also check whether the seasoning differs between the sample and the product for sale.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about differences between the sample and the sold product.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今は試食をこちらで下げます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will take the sample away for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。友人にも私へ渡さないよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者の試食共有も止める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I will also tell my friend not to pass a sample to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will also stop a companion from sharing a sample with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 説明後に購入されるか決められます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can decide whether to purchase after hearing the explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 対応が確認できるまでは、試食も購入も保留します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 両方の判断を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will hold off both sampling and purchasing until the necessary arrangements are confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hold off both decisions in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 両方の材料と調理条件を担当へ確認します。説明までは試食と購入を保留してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will ask the responsible staff about both products' ingredients and preparation conditions. Please hold off tasting and buying until the explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 履き心地はいかがですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 左右で違います。片足ずつ別の箱から試しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 左右別箱の試着を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: They feel different on each foot. I tried one shoe from each of two different boxes.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that you tried left and right shoes from different boxes.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: サイズ表示を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the size labels.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 右は二十六、左は二十六半です。このまま一組とは買いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 異サイズの現状を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The right is twenty-six, and the left is twenty-six and a half. I will not buy these as a pair like this.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the different sizes in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同じサイズの組を用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will prepare a pair in the same size.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 大きい方の両足で試したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同サイズ両足で再試着を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to try both shoes in the larger size.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request another fitting with both shoes in the same size in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらで座ってお試しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please sit here to try them.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。試した見本と販売用の組も後で照合したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見本と販売品を照合したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Afterwards I also want to compare the display shoes I tried with the pair for sale.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to compare the sample with the actual pair for sale.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二十六半の両足はいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: How do both shoes in twenty-six and a half feel?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 合います。左右の表示を確認して同サイズの一組にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 両足適合後に一組選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: They fit. I will check the labels on both sides and choose one pair in the same size.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will choose a pair after both shoes fit.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二十六半の販売用を一組ご用意します。混ざった見本はこちらで戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will prepare a pair for sale in twenty-six and a half. We will put the mixed display shoes back.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご家族とはぐれましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you become separated from your family?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。夫も探しに行こうとしていますが、まず合流場所を決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 合流場所を固定したいと求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My husband is about to go looking too, but first I want to set a meeting point.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a fixed meeting point in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お子さんの年齢と服装をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me your child's age and clothing.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 七歳で黄色い上着です。最後に屋台の前で見ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 子の特徴と最後の場所を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Seven years old, wearing a yellow jacket. I last saw the child in front of the food stalls.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the child's description and last-seen location in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内本部へ報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will report this to the information headquarters.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 夫へ本部へ来るよう連絡します。三人が別々に動かないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 配偶者へ本部待機を連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will contact my husband and ask him to come to headquarters. I will avoid having the three of us move separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tell your spouse in Japanese to wait at headquarters.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真があれば担当へ見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you have a photograph, please show it to the responsible staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 担当にだけ示します。ネットへ子どもの写真を投稿しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真は担当へ限定して示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will show it only to the staff. I will not post my child's photo online.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will show the photograph only to the responsible staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 本部で連絡を受けられるようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please make sure you can receive contact at headquarters.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 電話の音を確認しました。この番号へ連絡をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡を受けられる状態を整える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked my phone's sound. Please contact me at this number.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you are ready to receive contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本部の係へ情報を引き継ぎます。こちらの通路で本部へ進み、そこでご家族とお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass the information to the headquarters staff. Follow this passage to headquarters and wait there with your family.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今の状態を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me how you are feeling now.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 明日の予約がありますが、今夜から息苦しさもあり、相談に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 翌朝予約と今夜の変化を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have an appointment tomorrow, but I also developed difficulty breathing tonight, so I came to ask for help.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe tomorrow morning's booking and tonight's change in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約の有無と今の症状は別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check your current symptoms separately from whether you have an appointment.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日は咳だけでした。今の変化を先に伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昨日と現在の症状を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yesterday I only had a cough. I want to tell you about the current change first.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish yesterday's symptoms from the current symptoms in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: いつ変化に気付きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: When did you notice the change?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 夜九時ごろです。自分では予約まで待てるか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 変化時点と待機可否不明を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Around nine tonight. I cannot tell myself whether I can wait until the appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State in Japanese when the change occurred and that you do not know whether waiting is possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 医療職へすぐ引き継ぎます。同行者はいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will hand this over to medical staff immediately. Is someone with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人がいます。予約画面を取りに戻るより、ここで案内を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 資料回収より現場の案内を優先する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: A friend is with me. Rather than go back to get the booking screen, I will wait here for guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Prioritize guidance at the current location over retrieving documents in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 服用したものがあれば伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell us if you have taken anything.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 薬の袋を持っています。飲んだ時刻は記録で確認して伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 薬情報と時刻の記録を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have the medicine bag. I will check the record and tell you what time I took it.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show medicine information and the recorded time in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今の症状と九時ごろの変化を医療職へ引き継ぎます。こちらで直ちに案内を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass your current symptoms and the change around nine to medical staff. Please receive their guidance here immediately.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 朝食用なので、今温めるか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 朝食用の加温を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is for breakfast, so I am unsure whether to heat it now.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Consult in Japanese about heating food intended for breakfast.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 召し上がるのは何時ごろですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: About what time will you eat it?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 朝七時です。今夜温めて常温で置く予定にはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 消費時刻と常温放置しない方針を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Seven in the morning. I do not plan to heat it tonight and leave it at room temperature.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the eating time and that you will not leave it at room temperature in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 保存表示と期限をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the storage instructions and use-by date.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらは要冷蔵ですね。家まで十五分です。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 保存表示と移動時間を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: This says it needs refrigeration. It is fifteen minutes to my home.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the storage label and travel time in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 冷蔵で持ち帰られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you keep it chilled on the way home?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。家の冷蔵庫に入れ、食べる時の表示も見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自宅の保存方法を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will put it in my refrigerator at home and also check the instructions for when I eat it.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe your storage plan at home in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 飲み物も一緒の袋ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Will the drink go in the same bag too?

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 熱い飲み物は別袋にしてください。弁当は温めず買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未加温と熱飲料の別袋を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please put the hot drink in a separate bag. I will buy the boxed meal without heating it.
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Specify no heating and a separate bag for the hot drink in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 弁当は温めず、熱い飲み物と分けてお渡しします。保存表示を残してお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KNG-FUJISAWA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will leave the boxed meal unheated and hand it to you separately from the hot drink. Please keep the storage label attached when taking it home.
